summary: Make edited Telegram heartbeat timestamps self-explanatory
description: Telegram preserves the original bubble timestamp when an edit-in-place heartbeat is refreshed, so a bubble can visibly say hundreds of elapsed minutes next to an old send timestamp. Render a compact human duration plus an explicit last-updated wall-clock time inside the heartbeat, with deterministic regression coverage.
acceptance: An edited long-running heartbeat states both compact elapsed duration and the current update clock, so Telegram's unchanged original message timestamp cannot be mistaken for the heartbeat's freshness.
